h1: Custom Full Color Awards for Employee Recognition
metaTitle: Custom Full Color Awards | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom full color awards for employee recognition and events. Bulk pricing available at PerfectImprints.com.
introHtml: Full color awards let you reproduce your logo, a photo of the recipient, or a detailed scene with photographic clarity. Unlike single-color or foil-stamped plaques, full color sublimation or digital printing captures gradients and fine details on acrylic, crystal, and wood substrates. Recognition directors often choose full color for annual sales awards or service milestones where a personal photo or a vibrant company event image makes the honor more meaningful. The Lancaster Award and Acrylic Crescent Awards are popular choices for this decoration method.
heroAltText: Custom full color awards with personalized logos and photos on acrylic and crystal plaques
